sections.h2: India's worldwide iron and steel exports reach about USD 20.7 billion

chart.title: Iron and steel articles (HS73) edge out raw iron and steel (HS72) in export value
chart.sub: India's FY2025-26 worldwide exports of the two CBAM-covered chapters, USD million.
chart.source: Cross-sector trade-policy research repository; NITI Aayog Trade Watch.

sections.means: The two chapters together form the outer bound of exposure, since only part of their exports goes to the EU.

sections.h2: Only about USD 8.2 billion of iron and steel exports is EU-bound and CBAM-covered

chart.title: The EU-bound slice is smaller than the worldwide total
chart.sub: Iron and steel export value, USD billion.
chart.source: ICWA estimate; NITI Aayog Trade Watch; cross-sector trade-policy research repository.

sections.means: CBAM charges the EU-bound slice directly, while the worldwide total marks the outer bound.
